dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the symphony on the mural...

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Os
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, since Boethius has run off, guess we can finally play this mural symphony in peace!

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Os
dialogues.text: This piece of music depicts the first legendary voyage of the Sebastos to the land called Meropis, guided by the oracle Sybilla.

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Os
dialogues.text: This was the beginning of our ancient civilization, the beginning of all the stories that would follow.

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Os
dialogues.text: It being recorded here means that that fellow believed that the principle of cycles would cause the old civilization to resurface, resulting in the drama playing out over and over.

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Os
dialogues.text: But since it is a drama, then it needs a protagonist... and if you wish to enjoy the music, why don't you try playing the part?

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Os
dialogues.text: Of course, the musical score here will be transferred onto the "blank score" you retrieved previously. You can then listen to the song at any time.
